newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabian Defence Minister Prince Sultan urges Iran to boost ties with Gulf Arab states.
- Qatar set to ink deal with Exxon to set up a $1.2 billion gas-to-liquid conversion plant to produce synthetic crude oil.
- Kuwait plans foreign stakes in its utility firms.
- UAE deputy prime minister meets Mobil officials. New oil and petrochemical projects to boost the economy.
- 36.5 million dinars investment in Bahrain in 1996.
- United Arab Emirates call to foil Israeli settlement plan.
- Kuwait banks' assets move up one percent.
